gaps.explanation: p8 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints four enterprise fund columns (Electric, Water, Sewer, Sanitation) with no schedule of their own; detail[] has no business-type lines. Sum 2,068,005 = statement 2,068,005. Internal Service Fund column excluded.
